capability.detail: Windows shares C:\VeilShared as VeilShared; macOS mounts it over a loopback port forward.

guest.message: The agent created C:\VeilShared but cannot publish an SMB share without administrator rights.

hostMount.detail: /Volumes/VeilShared is not present, so the share is not mounted on this Mac.

nextActions: Creating an SMB share needs an administrator. In Windows, open PowerShell as administrator and run: New-SmbShare -Name VeilShared -Path C:\VeilShared -FullAccess $env:USERNAME
Give the Windows account a password. Windows refuses network sign-in for blank-password accounts, so the mount fails without one.
Then mount it on the Mac with: open smb://127.0.0.1:18445/VeilShared
